evidence.database: PostgreSQL 16 temporary isolated database with migrations through version 83

verifiedInvariants.replay: 100 API command deliveries converge on one import and 100 worker deliveries claim once then replay the terminal result
verifiedInvariants.invalidRows: malformed, duplicate and unsafe rows are rejected without removing valid normalized rows
verifiedInvariants.voluntaryDeparture: a membership in left state cannot be reactivated by an administrator CSV import
verifiedInvariants.deactivationSafety: deactivate_missing is applied only when the CSV has no rejected rows and revokes only enterprise-tenant sessions
verifiedInvariants.audit: one queued event, one completed event and row-level membership events retain the import correlation
